Version 1.1.1

- Version bump to avoid registry concurrency with 1.1.0.
- No engine or feature changes; core script remains unchanged.
- Changelog updated to reflect this versioning adjustment.

Version 1.1.0 — viral repackage with bilingual, EN-first documentation rewrite; engine unchanged.

- SKILL.md fully rewritten with detailed English and Chinese user guide, usage cases, and evidence.
- English description and interface improved for clarity and cross-language onboarding.
- Prominent examples and scoring bands now included for quick start.
- Documentation now emphasizes safety, zero dependencies, offline usage, and unchanged engine script (byte-identical to 1.0.0).
